prompt: Fix one observed Wingthing review-job reporting bug. During the live lease fixture, the job remained stage=implementation_submitting for minutes even though its exact implementer_run was already durably recorded and the coordinator was waiting on that child. In internal/reviewjob/job.go, preserve the existing *_submitting intent before launch, but after a successful nonempty child acknowledgment persist the appropriate implementation_running or review_running stage together with that exact child ID before waiting. These stages describe a confirmed supervised child being awaited, not a claim about a provider's internal activity. Do not publish a running-stage transition for an ambiguous or failed launch. Keep existing terminal status, deadlines, deduplication, revision bounds, patch handoff, independent test gates, and interruption-without-replay behavior unchanged. Add a deterministic test named TestReviewJobConfirmedRunStages in internal/reviewjob/job_test.go using controlled launch/wait gates, not sleep-based guesses. Cover implementation and review acknowledgments, still-unacknowledged submission, an ambiguous/failed acknowledgment, and returning to implementation on a requested revision; assert persisted stages and exact run IDs while the job is nonterminal. Keep this to the existing fixed workflow and these two files. Do not add a stage framework, new CLI/API, dependencies, commits, deployment, delegation, or unrelated fixes. Run the relevant review-job tests and return a concise implementation summary.
